claim: NOT RELEASE READY. This audit does not claim, and explicitly disclaims, public-sale readiness.
basis: RELEASE_READINESS.md's own release command gate passes locally (npm test, npm run build, npm audit --audit-level=high, git diff --check all PASS as of 2026-09-17), but that gate is explicitly scoped by the same document as only the repo-verifiable subset. Every other ship-criteria row (Core loop manual smoke test, PWA over real HTTPS, Accessibility scan/audit, Device coverage, Content playthrough) is UNKNOWN or NOT_STARTED, and all mandatory pre-publication commercial/legal work is unstarted.

No manual core-loop smoke test recorded (VS-04)

All commercial/legal pre-publication work unstarted: pricing, privacy policy, terms, age rating, asset-licensing sign-off (LEGAL-01/02/03)
Steamworks account/signing/notarization/store page not started (DESKTOP-03) if desktop/Steam release is pursued

README mission count (16) vs actual (17) doc drift (RISK-10)

Production build succeeds cleanly (tsc strict + vite)
Core architecture matches README's documented tech stack exactly (verified against package.json and source tree, not just asserted)
8 regions / 17 missions are real, content-validated, and cross-referentially consistent (contentValidation.test.ts)
do_not_claim: WCAG conformance (RELEASE_READINESS.md's own instruction, restated here)
'Art-complete' (VISUAL_STATE.md's own instruction: closed-beta visual review level only, not public-sale art-complete)
